protocol.sets: Same Dirichlet-multinomial union-region cohort as equal-cost experiment, fixed per k; m uniform on union_min..union_max; no rejected/resampled cases.
protocol.costs: Mean 1; kappa=mean/min; one_cheap, one_expensive, linear gradual. Ascending costs mapped to a seeded random permutation of original oracle IDs, fixed across all kappa and profiles.
protocol.rgs: Minimize cost under theorem sufficient constraints; full p denominator and peak stopping time; certified lower bound, no quantum simulation.
protocol.nested: Exact naive order DP per cost vector; SS follows that order, one test per level, integer-count optimization including final amplify. SS generally best found, not globally certified.
protocol.timing: Single-call diagnostics only: naive=order optimization, SS=that same order time plus SS extra time. Excludes instance generation/validation, cardinality acquisition, imports, I/O and plots. Not repeated timing benchmarks.
protocol.statistics: Ratio of sample mean costs, paired percentile bootstrap 95% CI, and per-instance win fractions. Incomplete cohort groups are explicitly marked and excluded from plots.
protocol.heatmaps: Two figures, each with three cost-profile panels. Shared log color scale centered at ratio 1; contours visualize mean-cost equality between sampled cells, not certified thresholds.
protocol.scope: This fixed union-size ensemble may contain redundant filters at large k; conclusions are specific to the ensemble, not a universal scaling claim.
